parsed.refutation_attempt: No untrusted input reaches the sprintf call. The format string '%06llu' is a compile‑time constant, so there is no opportunity for format string injection. The only source of data is the numeric timestamp parameter, which is correctly cast to unsigned long long. No path exists from an external source to the format string. Therefore the conditions for a CWE‑680 type vulnerability are not satisfied.
